items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: he was playing trumpet, and I was playing tenor banjo. He had, uh, Joe Welsh on a drum.

ctx.x: Yeah, violin. He had, um, um, he was playing trumpet, and I was playing tenor banjo. He had, uh, Joe Welsh on a drum. He had a fella called, uh, Clarence Paul on the saxophone. Paul. Paul. That's about, I believe that's about all he had. He was playing at the New Orleans Country Club. He had, he had, uh, the Santa Cendars contract with the Santa Cendars. He had the, uh, the Lions Club, and all them clubs. He had, uh, contract with all of them. Every, any, any dance given, any ball given at them places, that was…
Did that Lions Club the one way uptown, where they had the carnival parades?
